prompt: Create one complete production 2D sprite atlas for the original 1990s arcade basketball game JAMVERSE '96, exactly 42 DISTINCT full-body poses of Steeb, arranged in an exact 7-column by 6-row transparent grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Steeb is a small, stocky anthropomorphic wombat athlete, unmistakably an animal person with dense gray-brown fur, short compact legs, rounded wombat ears, a broad blunt furry muzzle, a wide black nose, expressive cheeky face, and stout muscular wombat build. Do not make him a human, do not give him a human face, no long tail, no giant stature. Keep his ears and muzzle clear and recognizable in every pose. Canon outfit: practical earth-toned olive-green field adventurer basketball uniform with rugged pockets, leather belt and simple court shoes sized for his broad animal feet; a small warm amber glass lantern is secured safely to the rear belt as a signature object, not held in the hands. He has normal animal paws, not human fingers. Preserve gray-brown fur and the same face/body in every drawing. Three-quarter view facing screen-right, face angled slightly toward viewer. Compact silhouette, same camera, scale and foot baseline across all frames. Crisp original late-1990s arcade sports illustration, bright readable highlights, strong dark outlines, dense but clean fur clusters. Each pose individually articulated and different; no duplicated holds. Strict pose sequence: frames1-6 relaxed ready idle with subtle breathing and weight shift; frames7-10 ball-ready receiving stance with empty paws; frames11-20 low right-paw dribble cycle, paws are empty because physics ball is added by the game, lowest reach on frame16; frames21-31 continuous running cycle with alternating compact legs and counter-swinging arms; frames32-42 low dribble-run sprint with alternating low paw reach, frame37 lowest reach. All42 full-body drawings independently drawn. Keep full ears, fur, paws, lantern, legs and feet inside each cell, separated from neighboring drawings by transparent clear space, no touching/cropping. Genuine RGBA alpha transparency. No ball, extra people, scenery, floor, shadows, glow, panels, words, numbers, checkerboard, fake grid lines, extra gear, stamps, official seals, or detached props. Exactly42 poses, 7 columns by6 rows.

review.source: Source passes exact42 separate full-body components, true RGBA, border and 7x6 order checks. Visual review confirms Steeb remains a compact stocky gray-brown anthropomorphic wombat with rounded ears, blunt muzzle, animal paws, olive field uniform and warm amber lantern secured to his belt.

assembly.operation: No assembly; all42 poses were generated on a single transparent 7x6 atlas.
